papers.headline: VLT and Keck recovery and characterisation of 2025 SC₇₉: linking 'Ayló'chaxnim and Atira asteroids
papers.summary: Asteroids near the boundary between the Atira and 'Ayló'chaxnim classes can trace dynamical links between the two populations, but their small solar elongations make recovery and physical characterisation difficult.
papers.title: VLT and Keck recovery and characterisation of 2025 SC₇₉: linking 'Ayló'chaxnim and Atira asteroids

papers.headline: SN 2026ahvu in NGC 1433 May Be a Prompt Type Ia Supernova with a Delay Time Under 100 Myr
papers.summary: SN 2026ahvu is a Type Ia supernova (SN) that occurred in the nearby galaxy NGC 1433. Using archival Hubble and JWST imaging from the PHANGS survey, we show that the SN lies within 0.19'' and 0.26'' of two UV-bright star clusters.
papers.title: SN 2026ahvu in NGC 1433 May Be a Prompt Type Ia Supernova with a Delay Time Under 100 Myr

papers.headline: Lessons from double-plane lenses for galaxy profiles, the Hubble tension, and the mass-sheet degeneracy
papers.summary: Double-plane lenses, like single-plane lenses, are subject to the mass-sheet degeneracy, a fundamental limit to our knowledge of the deflector mass profiles from lensing.
papers.title: Lessons from double-plane lenses for galaxy profiles, the Hubble tension, and the mass-sheet degeneracy
